answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, expired if not renewed by fresh work, idle agents bleed standing. A vertex of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ferrous of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
